helps:
Cold Magic adds a new
tower that is placed
on the side of the
road, it  does a
small amount of
damage but slows
enemies down, this
can be very useful to
allow your towers to
destroy more enemies
as they pass by. Cold
magic also has
another use that will
be explained later.

Fire Magic creates a
Fire Tower that is
placed on the
roadway, this will
burn and unit that
walks  through it.

Poison Magic adds poison
damage to all Plant
Towers. This not only
adds extra damage to
these towers, but the
monsters will stay
poisoned a short time
after being hit doing
some extra damage.

Towers Attack Speed will
slightly increase the
attack speed of all
towers placed on the
map and those you
build.

Towers Attack Range will
slightly increase the
attack range of all
towers placed on the
map and those you
build.

Towers Damage will
slightly increase the
damage of all towers
placed on the map and
those you build.

Disassemble Rate
increases the amount
of gold you get back
when you dismantle a
tower.

People's Resistance will
increase the
resistance your
townsfolk have to
monsters, so less
will die if you let a
monster through.

Gold Income will
increase the gold you
get slightly after
every round. This
skill is affected by
the amount of
townsfolk you have
left as well.
storyline:
Hordes of evil monsters
are intruding upon your
ancient kingdom.
You, as the protector of
the land, must build a strong
defence to protect the people
taking refuge in your castle.

Congratulations! Great work!
But don't waste your time.
Because you have to
move ahead and repulse
the siege of castle.

Well done! You have defeated
them! Now you have to make
your way through the rock.

Beware of countless green
sorcerers. They can treat
nearest monters.

It was not easy, but you have
great skill! The burning
sands of the desert awaits
you.   You must demonstrate
greater skill if you are
to succeed.

Finally you reached their
shelter! Impressive!
They are everywhere and
you have to protect the people!
But are you up to
the challenge..?

Let's close them way from
mountains! It is realy hard
mission.
Last mission! Good luck.

You're the master!
People are now free of endless intrudings
of evil monsters!
You're the real
King of your Kingdom!
tutorial:
This is the amount of gold and people you start
off with. Your gold will increase after every
round and for every monster you destroy. The
less people you have the less gold you will
get every round. If you run out of people, the
game is over.

You can scroll the camera around by using the
arrow keys, W,A,S,D or by moving the mouse to
the edge of the screen in the direction you
wish to go.

Press the Next button to continue...

These are your towers, each tower has a different
function. The Land tower can only attack
targets on the ground, the Magic tower can
only attack targets in the air and the Plant
tower can attack both but is weaker than the
other two. Each tower you build costs gold and
to upgrade them takes additional gold.

Now try and build a tower, look at its properties
and see the range it has currently, this will
all increase with improvements.

To build a tower, click on it's icon in the
bottom menu then click on the map near the
road to place it.

Well done, now you can upgrade your tower. Towers
start at level zero, which is not very strong
but the more you upgrade them they stronger
they become. It is better to have a single
upgraded tower than many low level towers.

To upgrade, select the tower that you want to
upgrade then, press the "Upgrade tower" button
in the lower right corner.

If you don't need this tower any more, you can
always sell it by pressing "Sell tower" button.
In this case you will recieve some gold back.
Initially it is 75% of tower cost.

You can also increase and decrease speed of
time with this slider. By clicking on Reset
marker you can return speed to normal.

We have no more time. The monsters are breaking
down the town gates and will arrive any
second. You can save your game between attacks
using the save game icon, but only before the
monsters start the attack, once the attack
starts, the game cannot be saved.

Press the Space Bar of the Alt Key to show/hide
the monsters' health. 

Press next to begin the battle...

During play, you gain experience. It is displayed
in the upper left hand corner, below the gold
amount. Using your experience, you can build
new magic towers and improve your current
towers damage, range and speed. You can also
add a special attack to make your Plant towers
more powerful. By pressing the "Magic and
Skills" button you can decide what to improve.
Hit next to see your skills screen and find
out what each choice can do.

Now you have a balloon that drops bombs on
monsters from above. To move the balloon,
simply right click on the road and it will
move to that location. The bombs have a small
area of effect that will hit all monsters
inside its range. You cannot increase its
range, but if you place points into Cold
Magic, your balloon's bombs have a small
chance to stun monsters as well. 
We have no more time. The monsters are crossing
the desert to get to the valley and will
arrive any second. 

Hit next and let the battle begin...

You must build towers and upgrade them.

Build tower keyboard shortcuts are "1,2,3,4,5"
keys.

To see monsters' health you can press "Space"
or "Alt" key.

Upgrade tower - "u" or "r".

Show/hide upgrades window - "e" or "F2".

Switch between towers- "Tab" key

Game Save - "F5", Load - "F9".
